selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Helion Robotics Ltd.
Effective: 12 March 2019
Term: 36 months, then successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 60 days' written notice.
Helion Robotics Ltd. may not assign this agreement without prior written notice to the provider. Notice is required; consent is not required for assignment to an affiliate.

selection_rationale: Clause kind 'assignment_competitor_prohibition' on MSA-HELION-2019 is classified from the contract header (counterparty/term) and the most relevant assignment, change-of-control, exclusivity, or term language in that file.
known_missing_information: Vocabulary does not define whether assignment_competitor_prohibition and competitor_assignment_prohibition are distinct clause kinds or aliases.
